description:
The BCH code builder carries its own least-common-multiple routine for polynomials that duplicates the core crate's implementation. Publish the core implementation and remove the duplicate.

## Background

`BchCode::lcm_poly` at `crates/gf2-coding/src/bch/core.rs:225` and `gf2_core::field::charpoly::poly_lcm` share identical gcd-then-quotient logic. The core version is crate-private, which is why the coding crate grew its own copy rather than calling it.

The fix runs in the other direction from the duplication: expose the operation as a method on the polynomial type in core, have the existing crate-private helper delegate to it, and delete the copy in the coding crate.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `FieldPoly` exposes a public least-common-multiple method in `gf2-core`.
- [hard] REQ-02: The crate-private `charpoly` helper delegates to that method rather than repeating the algorithm.
- [hard] REQ-03: `BchCode::lcm_poly` is removed and its call sites use the public method.
- [hard] REQ-04: The public method carries rustdoc stating its purpose and any panic conditions.
- [hard] REQ-05: BCH generator-polynomial construction produces identical results across the crate's existing BCH tests.
- [hard] REQ-06: The workspace test suite, clippy with warnings denied, and formatting all pass.
title: Promote polynomial LCM to a public FieldPoly method and drop the BCH copy
